description: This is a Dart source file that implements the login screen for a Flutter application. It defines a stateful widget 'LoginScreen' which manages user input for email and password, handles form validation, manages authentication state, and navigates between different app routes based on user roles and actions. It also imports several internal and external packages for UI components, routing, state management, and utility functions.

classes.name: LoginScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that provides the UI and logic for user login, including form validation, user input controls, and navigation based on authentication state.

classes.name: _LoginScreenState
classes.description: The private State class for LoginScreen, managing form state, user input controllers, and authentication handling.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Releases resources held by the email and password TextEditingControllers.

methods.name: _submit
methods.description: Validates the form and initiates the login process via the AuthProvider.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the login screen, displaying input fields, buttons, and handling navigation upon successful login.
